question: Separate physically short-supported cut-roof nodes, y-z eigenvector mass localization, and x-Neumann modes for the already observed native explicit leapfrog CFL failures without modifying any q0 acceptance.
prospective_gate: This complete plan must exist on the live GitHub working branch before any new real native HDF5 five-grid localization is computed; check plan bytes and live remote SHA, fail closed.

operator.Myz: physical positive row-sum true roof cut-Q1
operator.Kyz: full wet Cartesian 5point flux + exact inclined natural-Neumann cut-Q1

predeclared_analysis.roof_band_defined_by_absolute_signed_dis: abs(4-0.25*y-z) <= multiplier*h; include above-roof positive-support exterior Q1 nodes
predeclared_analysis.mass_localization_enrichment: mode_mass_fraction / physical_support_area_fraction, null if support area zero
predeclared_analysis.node_diagonal_Rayleigh_yz: Kyz_ii / Myz_ii; exact basis-node Rayleigh, provable <= complete yz lambda_max
predeclared_analysis.global_diagonal_Rayleigh_bound: max_i Kx_ii/Mx_ii + max_j Kyz_jj/Myz_jj; provable <= lambda_3d_max
predeclared_analysis.high_eigenvalue_split: lambda3d_max=lambda_x_max+lambda_yz_max; report x and yz fractional contributions
predeclared_analysis.native_leapfrog_limit: native dt² lambda <4, report all unstable 3D modes, never suppress or rescore
predeclared_analysis.all_five_vs_published_CFL: verify five max dt²lambda and unstable mode counts against previous pinned full evidence to 2e-9 absolute for CFL and exact counts
predeclared_analysis.full_3d_true_mass_symmetric_constant_and: preserve volume and Neumann constant and previously established affine check

interpretation: Eigenmode mass concentration and local Rayleigh lower bound are physical diagnostics. Do not claim specific roof sliver causes full original q0 nonconvergence without independent causal validation. Exact node diagonal Rayleigh explains CFL bound but not q0 transfer directly.
